problem: Authenticated partial/diff records inherited whole-draft zero counters from a generic empty findings default. An actual accepted/rejected revision comparison carried banned_pairs:0 and flags:0 even though surviving findings were not measured.
fix: Only authenticated graded or finished records with an actual findings array emit full-draft counters. All unmeasured statuses carry findings_measured:false and top-level certified:false. Missing completed inventory cannot certify. Authenticated coverage remains separate. Verify names its diff scope and points to lyric_grade/lyric_check.
consumer_review: Gemini completion accepts only lyric_revise exit0 with certified:true and exact final_draft/presentation digest; missing full inventory now forces certified:false at producer. Grade/check/verify cannot issue completion. Pruned history keeps meaning, which names unknown/unmeasured scope.
controls: graded actual-empty census reports measured zero
finished with missing inventory remains uncertified
actual banned draft versus unchanged diff preserves separate known-ban and unmeasured-comparison evidence
final_native_result: See connector-full-native-final.json for the separately source-attributed completed gate; this record captures the repair epoch, not the final qualification result.
